title: Tempered Symplectic Distinction For Quaternionic $GL_n(D)$: A Conjecture of PRASAD
summary: Let $F$ be a non-Archimedean local field of characteristic zero, let $D/F$ be the quaternion division algebra, and put $G_n = GL_n(D)$ and $H_n = Sp_n(D)$. We prove Prasad's revised conjecture on tempered representations with symplectic period.
